clauses.explanationTr: Spotify, abonelik ücretlerini tek taraflı olarak değiştirebilir; fiyat değişikliğinden sonra hizmeti kullanmaya devam ederseniz yeni fiyatı kabul etmiş sayılırsınız.
clauses.quote: Spotify may from time to time make changes to Paid Subscriptions, including recurring subscription fees, the Prepaid Period (for periods not yet paid), or Codes, and will communicate any price changes to you in advance. clauses.explanationTr: Ücretli abonelikler iptal edilene kadar süresiz olarak devam eder ve her fatura döneminin ilk günü otomatik olarak ödeme yönteminizden tahsilat yapılır.
clauses.quote: Paid Subscriptions continue indefinitely until cancelled. You will be billed on a recurring basis on the first day of each billing period and you will pay and you authorise us (or the applicable third party, if you sign up through a third party) to charge your payment method the then-current subscription fee.

clauses.explanationTr: Aboneliği iptal etseniz bile iptal, o fatura döneminin sonunda yürürlüğe girer ve kısmi dönemler için iade veya kredi yapılmaz.
clauses.quote: Unless otherwise indicated, cancellation will take effect from the end of the billing period in which you cancel and you will be downgraded to the free version of the Spotify Service. Unless otherwise required by law, we do not provide refunds or credits for any partial subscription periods, except as expressly stated in these Terms.
